title: Retire venue avatar primitive after shared contract migration
goal: Migrate approved consumers from components/venue/ui/avatar.tsx to components/ui/avatar.tsx, verify contract parity and zero-use evidence, then retire the venue twin.

out: components/venue/ui keep files and compatibility exceptions

acceptance_criteria: All consumers of the venue twin are audited and either migrated in scope or documented as an approved external dependency.
The canonical feature component preserves the public contract and focused checks pass.

The venue avatar copy lacks data-slot attributes; compare and approve parity before retirement. The venue twin is retained until migration and zero-use evidence are complete; no keep file or venue behavior is changed.

commands: rg -n "components/venue/ui/avatar|@/components/venue/ui/avatar" app components hooks lib apps __tests__ scripts --glob "*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}"
evidence: Scoped exact-path and alias import audit across app/, components/, hooks/, lib/, apps/, __tests__/, and scripts/ found 0 references to components/venue/ui/avatar or @/components/venue/ui/avatar; no live consumer requires an in-scope import migration.
Canonical register evidence lists components/venue/ui/avatar.tsx as retire-later with components/ui/avatar.tsx as its target and 0 detected consumers.

Public/export parity confirmed: both modules export exactly Avatar, AvatarImage, and AvatarFallback, each backed by the same @radix-ui/react-avatar element and ComponentPropsWithoutRef/ref contract, class defaults, and displayName assignments.

Implementation comparison found one intentional parity difference: components/ui/avatar.tsx adds data-slot=avatar, data-slot=avatar-image, and data-slot=avatar-fallback; components/venue/ui/avatar.tsx has none. These are non-behavioral DOM metadata attributes and do not change the Radix behavior, styling defaults, or public component API. Future import migration is safe with this approved difference; exact DOM-selector or snapshot consumers would need to account for the added attributes.
Focused ESLint passed for components/venue/ui/avatar.tsx and components/ui/avatar.tsx.
git diff --check passed for the two avatar files and docs/engineering.
npm run agents:validate passed: 17 agents, 93 tasks, 0 warnings, 0 errors.
